label: default agent • list installed skills (new read scope)
query: What skills do I have installed?
notes: Gap-closure read scope: the motivating query for expanding the list read beyond the original six scopes. Pins osaurus_inspect action 'list' scope 'skills' — a model that answers from the guide (osaurus_help) instead of live state is the exact failure the scope closes. The tool tolerantly executes {action:'list', filter:'skills'} as the skills list (deliberate API design), so either argument spelling satisfies the intent.
